long_biography.plain_text:
After graduating from the University of Florida, Joseph Christian ‘Chris’ LaFace joined RIPA & Associates, starting behind the wheel of an end-dump truck and rotating through field and office roles. The Tampa business had been founded by his father-in-law, Frank Ripa. As Ripa moved towards retirement, LaFace took charge of mass earthwork, utility installation and roadway construction across central Florida.

As president and chief executive, LaFace has overseen RIPA's expansion from a regional contractor into a large site-development enterprise. Its work spans residential communities, commercial and industrial sites, schools and hospitals, supported by an equipment fleet and an affiliated asphalt-and-concrete operation. His operating approach emphasizes repeat business, customer service and delegation to experienced project teams.
